build_fuse_fx: fuse modules like conv+bn and conv+bn+relu in a PyTorch model for quantization
build_prepare_fx: prepare a PyTorch model for post-training quantization by inserting observers using a qconfig mapping
build_prepare_qat_fx: prepare a PyTorch model for quantization aware training by inserting fake quantize modules
build_convert_fx: convert a calibrated or trained PyTorch model to a backend-specific quantized model
build_convert_to_reference_fx: convert a calibrated or trained PyTorch model to a reference quantized model for custom backends
